# SEIS Accountants

> SEIS and EIS accountants for UK founders raising seed and growth
> capital. We file HMRC advance assurance, draft SEIS1 and EIS1
> compliance statements, distribute investor certificates, and monitor
> the three-year qualifying period. Every engagement starts with a fixed
> written quote, with no obligation.

## What this site is

seisaccountants.co.uk is a UK SEIS and EIS accountancy service focused
specifically on the SEIS and EIS lifecycle. Founders submit a short
enquiry describing their company and the stage of scheme work they need,
and we come back within 48 hours with a fixed written quote covering the
scope of work.

## Services

We handle the full SEIS and EIS lifecycle:

- SEIS advance assurance with HMRC's Venture Capital Reliefs team
- EIS advance assurance, including knowledge-intensive company status
- Share issuance and cap table maintenance for SEIS and EIS rounds
- SEIS1 and EIS1 compliance statement drafting and HMRC filing
- SEIS3 and EIS3 investor tax certificate distribution
- Three-year qualifying-period monitoring with transaction clearance
- R&D tax credit claims (merged scheme) for SEIS and EIS-backed companies

## Coverage

We work UK-wide with founders across England, Scotland, Wales, and
Northern Ireland. The SEIS and EIS qualifying conditions are uniform
across the UK and HMRC's Venture Capital Reliefs team is centralised, so
the specialism is genuinely UK-national. The majority of engagements run
fully remotely. Priority city hubs include London, Manchester,
Cambridge, Edinburgh, Bristol, Brighton, Leeds, Birmingham, Oxford,
Reading, Belfast, and Cardiff.

## Free tools provided on the site

- R&D tax credit estimator (/guides/rd-tax-credits-uk-startups/)
- SEIS/EIS eligibility checker (/guides/seis-eis-guide-uk-startups/)

## How an engagement works

1. Founder submits the enquiry form with contact details and the SEIS
   stage they are at
2. We come back within 48 hours with a fixed written quote for the scope
   of work
3. Once the quote is accepted, we prepare and file the work with HMRC as
   the authorised agent
4. There is no obligation to proceed before the quote is accepted
